messages:
Alex M: FYI seeing 2xx->5xx spike on /v1/generate from prod canaries. Is there a known toggle for the new streaming pipeline?
Priya S: yes, feature key is streaming_v2. SRE oncall or Incident Commander can disable. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/feature-kill-switch 
Alex M: who exactly has authority? want to avoid cross-team reverts.
Priya S: short answer: oncall SRE, eng-oncall lead, or IC. Product PM should be notified but not required to flip in P1.
Jamal R: adding guardrails: always add incident id and reason when flipping, and set a TTL <= 1h unless Eng Lead approves extension.
OncallBot: Reminder — to flip use the internal toggle API or the /toggle Slack command. All flips are logged to audit-flags (Datadog + S3).
Priya S: CLI example:
```
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggles/streaming_v2 
  -d '{"enabled": false, "comment": "incident:1755001234 latency spike, oncall Priya S"}'
```
Priya S: Or via Slack: `/toggle streaming_v2 off reason:"latency spike" incident:1755001234` — this will auto-annotate the audit log.
Emma T: Verification steps after flip: 1) check /v1/generate 5xx rate drops to baseline within 2 minutes 2) confirm canary requests use fallback model 3) post a short note in #incidents and this thread.
Alex M: If API returns 200 but errors persist, what then?
Priya S: If toggle didn't help within 5 mins escalate to eng-runtime and eng-platform. Ping @eng-runtime and @eng-platform, and attach request-id + trace links.
Jamal R: Also — if the toggle endpoint itself fails, do NOT try direct DB toggles. Call eng-infra pager and follow emergency access path in runbook (requires multi-sig: oncall + eng lead).
Priya S: Audit expectations: every flip must include `comment` and `incident` fields. SRE-Escalations will reconcile within 24h and open an RCA ticket if toggle was used.
SRE-Escalations: Confirmed — logs for flips go to logs/flags/streaming_v2 and we tag with incident id. We also generate an immutable entry in the compliance bucket.
Alex M: Ok flipping now (IC ok'd).
Priya S: I'll perform so we avoid race. Executing toggle...
OncallBot: Command received from Priya S, action=disable, feature=streaming_v2, incident=1755001234. Audit id: af-20260317-09a7.
Priya S: Done. Metrics show error rate down from 9% -> 1.2% in 90s. Fallback model in use.
Emma T: Verified traces look clean, canary latency back to normal. Notifying Product.
Alex M: Great. Please keep TTL at 30m for now, and schedule a rollback test once RCA is ready.
Priya S: TTL set: 30m. Will update incident with steps taken and next actions.
Alex M: Thanks team. If anyone flips again, @mentions this thread and include the audit id.
SRE-Escalations: Closing loop here — will add a compliance note and follow-up action item for hardening the toggle endpoint.
